sn30.3:1.2: aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn30.3:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn30.3:1.4: idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī.
sn30.3:1.8: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn30.3:1.9: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn30.3:1.10: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
